description: Canonical error codes emitted by every language's canonicalizer. Negative test vectors assert the exact code; cross-language consistency requires identical codes.

codes.NON_FINITE_FEATURE: Input contains NaN, +Inf or -Inf. Such values are REJECTED outright; only ordinary finite numbers are clamped to the schema bounds.
codes.ROW_SIZE_MISMATCH: Binary row is not exactly 548 bytes.
codes.RESERVED_NONZERO: The 2-byte reserved field is not zero.
codes.INVALID_LABEL: label is not in {-1, +1} for a valid data row.
codes.FEATURE_OUT_OF_RANGE: A stored feature falls outside the signed int32 range (corruption).
codes.INVALID_ROW_ID: row_id is negative or, where an ordering is asserted, does not equal the physical index.
